lab_questions.title: Detect Duplicate Payment Transactions
lab_questions.description:
A payment gateway fraud engine checks incoming customer transactions to flag accidental duplicate charges. A duplicate is flagged if the exact same transaction amount appears more than once within any sliding window of K consecutive transactions.

Your task is to read N (total number of transactions) and K (sliding window limit), followed by N transaction amounts. Output DUPLICATE if any transaction amount recurs within K positions of a previous identical amount, or CLEAN otherwise.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
